name: social-matchmaker
description: A platform where users earn money by successfully matching friends. Features transparent betting on relationship longevity, matchmaker reputation scores, and payouts for successful long-term matches. Monetize your matchmaking intuition!

userStories.title: Project Setup & Infrastructure
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the base Next.js 14 project with Supabase for the matchmaking marketplace.
acceptanceCriteria: Tailwind CSS with fun social palette (vibrant purples, pinks, greens)
shadcn/ui with button, card, avatar, badge, dialog components

userStories.title: Database Schema Design
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the schema for users, matches, bets, and payouts.
acceptanceCriteria: user_profiles table (id, user_id, display_name, avatar_url, matchmaker_score, total_earnings, matches_made, successful_matches)
friend_connections table (id, user_id, friend_user_id, status, created_at)
match_proposals table (id, matchmaker_id, person1_id, person2_id, pitch_text, status, created_at)
matches table (id, proposal_id, person1_accepted, person2_accepted, started_dating_at, relationship_status, last_verified_at)
bets table (id, match_id, bettor_id, predicted_duration_months, amount, payout_multiplier, status, created_at)
payouts table (id, bet_id, user_id, amount, type, processed_at)
notifications table (id, user_id, type, content, read, created_at)

userStories.title: Authentication System
userStories.description: As a user, I want to sign up and login to participate in matchmaking.
acceptanceCriteria: Auto-create user_profiles and wallet on signup
Protected routes for dashboard, matches, wallet

userStories.title: Landing Page
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want to understand the platform and sign up.
acceptanceCriteria: Hero: 'Turn Your Matchmaking Skills Into Cash'
How it works: 1) Connect Friends, 2) Make a Match, 3) Earn When It Lasts
Earnings showcase: example payouts for successful matches

userStories.title: Profile Setup & Friends Import
userStories.description: As a new user, I want to set up my profile and connect with friends.
acceptanceCriteria: Invite friends via email or shareable link
Minimum 2 friends required to make matches

userStories.title: Create Match Proposal
userStories.description: As a matchmaker, I want to propose a match between two friends.
acceptanceCriteria: Select person 2 from friends list (different person)
Write pitch text explaining why they'd be good together
Submit sends notification to both people

userStories.title: Match Acceptance Flow
userStories.description: As someone who was matched, I want to accept or decline the match.
acceptanceCriteria: See who matched you and their pitch
See basic info about the other person
If both accept, match status becomes 'active'
If either declines, match status becomes 'declined'

userStories.title: Active Matches Dashboard
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see all my active matches and proposals.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard at /dashboard with tabs: My Matches, Made by Me, Pending
My Matches: relationships I'm in from being matched
Made by Me: matches I created as matchmaker
Each card shows: people involved, status, duration, bets placed
Quick actions: verify milestone, view details

userStories.title: Betting System - Place Bet
userStories.description: As a user, I want to bet on how long a match will last.
acceptanceCriteria: Bet modal on active match pages
Select predicted duration: 1 month, 3 months, 6 months, 1 year, 2+ years
Payout multiplier shown based on prediction (longer = higher payout)
Confirm bet deducts from wallet balance
Bet saved to bets table with status 'active'

userStories.title: Milestone Verification
userStories.description: As someone in a match, I want to verify relationship milestones.
acceptanceCriteria: Milestone verification prompt at 1 month, 3 months, 6 months, 1 year
Both people must verify for milestone to count
If ended, select approximate end date

userStories.title: Payout System
userStories.description: As a bettor, I want to receive payouts when my bets win.
acceptanceCriteria: Automatic payout calculation when milestone verified
Bettors who predicted duration <= actual duration win
Matchmaker gets bonus payout at each milestone their match reaches

userStories.title: Wallet & Transactions
userStories.description: As a user, I want to manage my wallet and see transactions.
acceptanceCriteria: Transaction history: bets placed, winnings, matchmaker bonuses

userStories.title: Matchmaker Leaderboard
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see top matchmakers and compete.
acceptanceCriteria: Rankings by: total earnings, success rate, matches made
Each entry shows: rank, avatar, name, stats
Current user highlighted if on leaderboard
Time filters: all time, this month, this week

userStories.title: Public Matchmaker Profile
userStories.description: As a user, I want to view other matchmakers' profiles and stats.
acceptanceCriteria: Stats: matches made, success rate, total earnings, avg match duration
Add friend button if not connected

userStories.title: Notifications System
userStories.description: As a user, I want to receive notifications for important events.
acceptanceCriteria: Notification types: new match proposal, match accepted/declined, bet won/lost, milestone due, payout received
Click notification goes to relevant page

userStories.title: User Settings
userStories.description: As a user, I want to manage my account settings.

userStories.title: Mobile Navigation
userStories.description: As a user, I want intuitive mobile navigation.
acceptanceCriteria: Bottom nav: Home, Matches, New Match, Wallet, Profile
